svg.title: DIA-002B · No wheel stops alone
svg.desc: An engraved plate of four toothed wheels on an iron frame, meshed in a closed ring: two large wheels left and right, two small wheels above and below. They are labelled labs, investors, hyperscalers and neoclouds. Arrows show each wheel turning against its neighbours, so each is driven by one and drives the next. One tooth, seated between two teeth of the next wheel, is drawn in rust. A wheel that stops takes the force of the other three on its teeth.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 2 · WHY IT'S MOVING SO FAST
Each wheel is turned by one neighbour
Stop one wheel, and its teeth
take the force of the other three.
DIA-002B · The firms that invest in and sell to one another, drawn as a closed train of gears. Whichever slows first pays first.
